source_text: Post haec Moyses iubetur adscendere et speculari. Adscensio ad actus, specula ad fidem. Qui prospicit hostem Pharaonis a tergo, orat et stat.
pass_a_gloss: After these Moses is-commanded to-ascend and to-watch. Ascent to acts, watchtower to faith. Who looks-out enemy of-Pharaoh from behind, prays and stands.
pass_b_english: Moses is told to look out as from a watch-tower. Ascent belongs to deeds; the lookout belongs to faith. Seeing Pharaoh’s host behind, the people must stand still and see the Lord’s salvation.
